requirements_summary: SMB support platform building an in-app chat assistant. Primary needs: sub-300ms median for short-turn chat (<=64 tokens), p95 under 700ms for EU users; cost-conscious (keep token spend low in production); want hosted API first (self-serve), ability to route EU traffic to EU region; basic SSO + audit logs required for enterprise customers later.
notes:
Lead arrived via blog post about low-latency inference. Early discovery: trying hosted_api with free credits. Symptoms: intermittent high tail latency for EU-based testers (~400-750ms p95 on identical prompts), AI chat feels sluggish leading to drop in demo conversions. Key constraints and ask lines below.

- Quote from PM on 2026-03-02 call: "If EU users wait >500ms they abandon the flow. We need predictable latencies."
- Integration: using node SDK, default region unspecified -> likely hitting us-east by default from EU testers.
- Current config: model=gpt-like-small (third-party), max_tokens=256, streaming enabled, client timeouts default (10s), retry logic naive (client-side fixed 3 retries).
- Observed metrics: median token latency ~120ms in us-east, eu-west median ~200ms; p95 eu-west spikes to 650-750ms under bursty load (10-20 rps).
- Cost sensitivity: prefer smaller base model and batching/caching recommendations; willing to trade slight quality for 2-3x cost reduction.
- Model routing needs: prefer regional routing rule (eu requests -> eu model endpoint) and fallback to us-east only if eu capacity exhausted. Interested in auto-fallback but want SLA on routing.
- Security: trial customers ok with public cloud, but PM requests SSO (SAML) availability for enterprise pilot in 6-8 weeks and audit log samples now.
- POC ask from SE: compare two runs (a) us-east default, (b) explicit eu-west routing + tuned timeout/retries + prompt trimming. Measure median/p95, token cost.
- Perf tuning guidance to provide: region choice checklist, streaming timeout recommendations (client read timeout ~2x median response time per average prompt length), prompt length guidance (truncate long system messages, use retrieval + distillation to reduce generation tokens), enable prefix caching for repeated contexts, suggest model-size/quantization options and batch-size targets for 5-25 rps.
- Short notes about handling streaming timeouts: recommend using 1200ms client-side initial_socket_timeout for EU until p95 improves; implement exponential backoff with jitter for retries; server-side keepalive/default downstream timeout suggestions included in runbook.
sales_play_notes: SMB inbound - emphasize quick wins: region selection + simple timeout/retry changes -> measurable UX lift. Offer 7-day perf POC free credits + sample runbook. If POC shows >30% p95 improvement, propose 6-12 month hosted plan. Low friction onboarding important.
